evidence.note: mine(): a run is attributed to a worktree only when its enterable work-dir ancestor resolves to the same common-dir store; otherwise it is reported from the main checkout, never dropped
legacy location scanned before the common store with id dedupe, so a run renamed mid-scan is seen in one or the other
enterableAncestor terminates at the filesystem root; work_dir is enforced absolute at init and fork (machine.go:108, fork.go:173) so the relative-path '.' fixpoint cannot occur
NewCommonDirStore uses layout metareview/runs; runsDir, validate and List all derive from the same layout slice
FSSidecar CommonDir path mirrors the store layout
doc comment for TestMigrateLegacyRowsIsLenientAndRunsOnce now sits above its own test (prior-round nit fixed)
Targeted go test ./internal/status ./internal/repo ./internal/fsm/record pass at this head

findings.note: mine() spawns two git subprocesses (StoreDir, Toplevel) per abandoned run with a recorded work dir on the Stop-hook path; fine for typical counts, could memoise by ancestor if abandoned runs accumulate.
enterableAncestor passes the magic number 0x1 to syscall.Access; a named X_OK constant would read better (the comment explains it).
